Claim → proof object. `pattern` is the regex evidence_audit.py uses to find the claim in
. `proof` is a site-relative path to a redacted document image/PDF the page must link to (href or ) wherever the claim is made more than once, or the literal string NOT FETCHED. `anchor` is the section id that owns the claim. `confirmed` is the breeder confirmation date. Empty at the system transfer (spec §1). The first row, `parents-dna-clear`, entered on 2026-09-23 (Known Issue 40) at proof NOT FETCHED: data/faq.json and the migrated pages say the parents are DNA tested clear of L-2-HGA and HC-HSF4, rules/copy.md keeps every health entity NOT FETCHED until the certificate is on file, and none is — so the claim is recorded as unproven, never as proven. evidence_audit.py warns wherever a page repeats it and query_augment.py will not answer a new page's question from a bank row that makes it. On 2026-09-29 the breeder answered that she holds no certificate (answer board q01): the row stays at proof NOT FETCHED with `confirmed` null, which is all the schema allows for a claim with no proof, and its `barrier` records why; every page now names the tests and states no result, so the pattern is a tripwire, not a record of live copy. If a certificate is ever put on file, the site path of its redacted copy replaces NOT FETCHED and `confirmed` takes the breeder's date. The BVA hip/elbow scores and the PHPV test enter the same way. The second row, `tests-named-no-result`, entered on 2026-10-04 (visual-intelligence audit, rec 10): it records the London page NAMING the four tests as ruling q01 allows, at proof NOT FETCHED with `confirmed` null like the first, and its `barrier` says why no proof object exists; it covers `dna-test` and `health-tested` only, so a sentence stating a result is still caught by `dna-clear` and by the row above. Rows three to six entered on 2026-10-04 from the breeder's answers to the London visual-intelligence batch (answer board q06, q07, q08; docs/reference/answer-board/answers/2026-10-04-london-visual-intel-decisions-2026-10-04.md): the parents' Kennel Club registration with the KC registration application form going home, the vet-signed health card, home-raised litters and after-collection support. Each is `confirmed` 2026-10-04 and its `proof` is that rulings file (repository path), as the controller directed; its `basis` says why it is not a served document and why its pattern is scoped to one London sentence.

The pattern matches only the London page's naming sentences and refuses any of them that carries a result word (clear, passed, negative, normal, unaffected, came back, result), and it covers dna-test and health-tested only, never dna-clear (visual-intelligence audit 2026-10-04, rec 10).

All pups come with their KC Reg application form so the new owner can register the pup themselves." Pages say the KC registration application form goes home, never that a puppy is already registered. The proof is that rulings file in the repository, not a redacted document served on the site, so no page can link it; the pattern is scoped to the one London sentence that makes the claim, so claim-bound-to-proof (a claim made twice must link its proof) is not met by a second mention elsewhere. _vocabulary_comment: Health and credential vocabulary (parity build Task 20). evidence_audit.py `claim-unledgered` reads every sentence of <main> that matches one of these patterns and requires a `claims` row whose pattern matches the same sentence, or a LICENCE_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER / LEGAL_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER. A hit is cleared only by a `claims` row whose `covers` lists that vocabulary id, and a placeholder excuses only its own id (LICENCE_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER: licensed-breeder; LEGAL_CLAIM_PLACEHOLDER: none of these ids). Not claims, each judged inside the hit's own clause (clauses end at a dash, ; : ? and a comma that opens a question): a question, a denial (not/never/no within three words before it, not across a comma; "not only" is no denial), advice (a clause starting "Ask to see" / "Ask for") and a reference ("page on/for/about the", "results for", "more about the" just before it). Preview pages (board-preview/, kit-preview) are not checked. ERROR on a new location, comparison or blog page; WARN elsewhere. To state a new claim, add its `claims` row first (proof NOT FETCHED until the document is on file) — never widen or delete a vocabulary pattern to clear a finding.
